morphology.pattern_note: 英语来源的整词，不按马来语词缀拆分；作人名时写作 Katniss。音标为英语读音；缺失的音节与爪夷文资料保留 null。

senses.zh_definition: 凯特尼斯；英语人名，尤其指苏珊·柯林斯《饥饿游戏》系列的主人公 Katniss Everdeen。
senses.en_definition: A given name, notably that of Katniss Everdeen, the protagonist of Suzanne Collins's The Hunger Games series.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang, khususnya Katniss Everdeen, watak utama dalam siri The Hunger Games karya Suzanne Collins.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，正常行文须大写；此处 noun 包括专有名词。不能把该人名解释为普通马来语词。status 沿用指定格式，不构成 DBP 收词认证。下列为名称组合，不代表经语料统计确认的高频搭配。[Scholastic 作者访谈](https://mediaroom.scholastic.com/files/EXCERPT-FROM-The-Hunger-Games-Special-Edition-by-Suzanne-Collins.pdf)

senses.zh_definition: 英语植物俗名，指慈姑属某些具有可食地下块茎的水生植物。
senses.en_definition: An English common name for certain aquatic Sagittaria plants with edible underground tubers.
senses.ms_definition: Nama umum bahasa Inggeris bagi tumbuhan air tertentu dalam genus Sagittaria yang mempunyai ubi yang boleh dimakan.
senses.nuances: 这是英语植物名称，可在马来语中作为外语名称引用；不是已核实的标准马来语植物名，也不能仅凭该俗名确定物种。此义通常小写。[Scholastic 作者访谈](https://mediaroom.scholastic.com/files/EXCERPT-FROM-The-Hunger-Games-Special-Edition-by-Suzanne-Collins.pdf)

dual_scenarios.ms: Laporan ini membincangkan peranan Katniss Everdeen sebagai watak utama dalam novel The Hunger Games.

dual_scenarios.en: This report discusses Katniss Everdeen's role as the protagonist of The Hunger Games.

etymology.historical_story: Suzanne Collins explained that she discovered the name while researching edible plants for survival. The arrowhead plant suggested several features of her heroine: nourishing underground tubers, defensive arrow-shaped leaves, and small flowers. She chose Katniss from its alternative names, linking the character's identity with survival and archery. [Author interview](https://mediaroom.scholastic.com/files/EXCERPT-FROM-The-Hunger-Games-Special-Edition-by-Suzanne-Collins.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读作近似“凯特尼斯”：把名字与背弓箭的女孩、箭头形叶片连在一起记；这是形象联想，不是词根拆解。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 讨论文学角色可直接称 Katniss；若是真人姓名，应遵循本人认可的读音与称呼。
